facts.fact: The article says a data owner cannot transfer data to another country unless the receiving country gives sufficient protection (Article 9 of the Data Protection Act, Law 2008-12), and the CDP must be informed before any transfer and authorisation sought; no date given for the statement, so the document published date 2018-05-11 is used.
facts.system: Data Protection Act (Law 2008-12 of 25 January 2008), Article 9
